title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings `strs`, put strings that are anagrams of each other into the same group and return all the groups. The groups, and the strings inside each group, may be in any order.
constraints: strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters
hints: Anagrams look identical once you ignore letter order. Can you compute a canonical 'signature' for each word?
A word's sorted letters, or its 26-element letter-count tuple, is the same for all anagrams of it.
Use a dictionary from signature to list of words, append each word to its signature's list, and return the values.
starterCode:
class Solution:
    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: List[str]) -> List[List[str]]:

solution.explanation: Two words are anagrams exactly when they share the same multiset of letters, so use that as a dictionary key. We build the key as a tuple of 26 letter counts (sorting the word also works), then append each word to the list stored under its key. With n words of length at most k, building each key costs O(k), giving O(n * k) time and O(n * k) space for the groups.
